name: pico
short: An LLM-backed Discord presence that decides whether to react, then acts only via tools
description: Pico watches messages in servers where it's enabled, decides whether a message deserves a reaction, and if so, acts exclusively through a bounded tool-calling loop -- never a raw LLM text send. Ships a reply tool, whatever any other cog has registered into corridor's cross-cog tool registry, and (once [p]pico architecturl is set) an A2A client tool to delegate sub-tasks to the architect cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog reads recent Discord message content in servers where it is enabled, and sends that content (plus channel history used as context) to corridor's configured LLM endpoint, and -- if the consult_architect tool is used -- forwards the LLM-generated prompt text to architect's configured A2A endpoint. It stores per-server enabled state and bot-owner turn-budget/prompt/architect-URL settings in Red's Config store; the LLM connection itself (including the virtual key) is stored by corridor.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Configure the shared LLM connection with [p]corridor llm endpoint/key/model (bot owner), then enable a guild with [p]pico enabled true.
